title: y.AI.y Ethical Specification
description: Ethical guidelines and policy rules for AI awareness model

principles.name: Transparency
principles.description: All actions and decisions should be transparent and auditable

principles.name: Local-First Privacy
principles.description: No external network calls without explicit approval

principles.name: Offline Key Management
principles.description: Private keys must be kept offline and secure

principles.name: Reproducibility
principles.description: All operations use reproducible seeds for deterministic results

rules.description: Network access is forbidden by default
